- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Location: lines 20707-20708 (wave judge NOTE prefix) and 18687-18688 (review-blocked judge NOTE prefix)
  Issue: The truncation/elision NOTE prefix (~230-250 bytes per PR) is added to PR_DIFF but is NOT subtracted from the shared JUDGE_PR_DIFFS_TOTAL_MAX_BYTES budget. With default values (524288 budget + ~250 KB static context) this stays under the 1 MB codex cap, but an operator who raises JUDGE_PR_DIFFS_TOTAL_MAX_BYTES near the cap (e.g. 786432) will trip the hard skip because N truncated/elided PRs each inject ~250 bytes that the budget doesn't account for.
  Suggested minimal fix: Track per-PR note overhead in the budget decrement — e.g. deduct the prefix's byte length (computed once as `${#NOTE_PREFIX}`) in the same `_judge_pr_diff_budget_left=$(( ... ))` line, so the NOTE bytes count against the budget just like the embedded diff bytes do.
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
